svg.aria-label: Workflow: an ISS photograph passes through YOLO11n-face detection, score filtering and duplicate removal, then ten face crops are classified by saved S5. Eleven people were present; one sideways face was missed. The Score panel shows separate recorded results: YOLO produced 401 boxes on 80 NASA photos, 359 matched to YuNet and 42 additional boxes; inspection found 41 faces and one hand among those extras. S5 achieved 62.44% accuracy and 0.562 macro F1 on the FER2013 test set.
